title: ArmDecision
description: Outcome of the arm gate for a watchlist trigger: whether to arm the trigger and at what size multiplier. Returned by the arm-decision step toward the trigger-strategy workflow.

arm.description: True to arm the trigger for subsequent fire evaluation; false to drop it.

size_multiplier.description: Position-size multiplier applied to the base allocation when the trigger eventually fires. 0 disables sizing without disarming.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the arm decision (audit).
